protocol: Pre-registered before the first SPORE ingest or detector call on this clip: this probe file, the play_0 manifest entry, the run configuration (state_surface_support=true), and the registration test are committed together. Labels come from visual inspection of a 1 fps contact sheet plus full frames at 10, 20, 30 and 40 s; the query detector was not consulted. The window is a stable living-room seating area: a round coffee table with a red/white board-game box, a gray sofa, a beige pouf, and a navy blanket on the rug. A 'no' label means the object is not visible anywhere in the window. This is the pre-registered test of the surface-head fallback that was post-hoc on play_2.

questions.query: Is there a box on the table?
questions.human_evidence: Red/white board-game box on the round coffee table; visible in most frames and still present at 40 s.

questions.query: Is there a sofa on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Gray fabric sofa at the back of the seating area, standing on the rug/floor.

questions.query: Is there a blanket on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Dark navy blanket/throw spread on the rug, clearly visible from the middle of the window onward.

questions.query: Is there a plate on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No plate anywhere in the window; this is a board-game scene, not a meal.

questions.query: Is there a cup on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No cup or glass anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a bottle on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No bottle anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a laptop on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No laptop anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a hammer on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No hammer anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is the box still on the table?
questions.human_evidence: The board-game box remains on the coffee table at 40 s.

questions.query: Is the sofa still on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: The sofa does not leave the seating area.
The box stays on the coffee table for the whole window.
The sofa is static in the seating area.
